text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mubarak discusses future of investment in Egypt with officials from world's largest financial institution. President of Merril Lynch says Egypt's economic reform programme is one of the best models in the world.
- Mubarak and Qaboos continue talks on peace process and Arab issues. President briefs Omani sultan on Egypt's efforts to restart Arab-Israeli talks.
- Mubarak and Qaboos to examine progress at Toshka project on Tuesday.
- Egyptian-Saudi committee to meet in Cairo on Thursday.
- Prime minister and 14 ministers to discuss ways to boost football in Egypt.
- Defence minister says armed forces aim to provide fighters with most modern training methods.
- Arab information ministers meeting in Cairo condemn Congress resolution to move U.S. embassy in Israel to Jerusalem.
- Airport security officials foil attempt to smuggle antiquties to Switzerland.
- Shura Council report says average lifetime of Egyptian is 65 years.
- Court orders early retirement for manager who harassed female employee.
